=== cf
--- module
; TrustIr text format v1

fn @cf(functy.0) {
    ; #producer: clean
bb0(%0: u32):
    %1 = const u32 10
    %2 = icmp ult u32 %0, %1
    condbr %2, bb1, bb2
bb1:
